UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's public profile information.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

badges.description: A list of badges the user has earned.

SavedArticle.title: Saved Article
SavedArticle.description: Represents a user's saved article from the Awareness Hub.

slug.description: The slug of the saved article.

savedAt.description: The timestamp when the article was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public profile information for each user.

/users/{userId}/savedArticles/{articleId.description: Stores articles a user has saved.
